sub_theme: Growing and Change (Me as a Baby to Now)

lessons.title: How I Have Grown This Year
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to describe one way they have changed since September.
lessons.starter_activity: Look at a photo from the start of the year (if available).
lessons.main_activity: Discuss how children have grown/changed this year (taller, more independent, new skills), sharing with the group.
key_questions: How have you changed since September?
What are you proud of?

differentiation.extension: Explain change in detail with reasoning

lessons.assessment_notes: Note reflective self-awareness and growth mindset — evidence for PSED.1.
lessons.plenary: Class recap of ways everyone has grown.
lessons.home_link: Look at old photos together and talk about how you've grown.

lessons.title: Me as a Baby
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to describe something they could do as a baby vs now.
lessons.starter_activity: Look at a baby photo of the teacher and guess who it is.
lessons.main_activity: (If available) children look at their own baby photos, discussing what they could and couldn't do then.
resources_needed: Baby photos from home (optional), discussion prompts
key_questions: What could you do as a baby?
What can you do now that you couldn't then?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note understanding of past vs present, building on Week 1 — evidence for UTW.1.
lessons.plenary: Share one 'I used to... but now I can...' sentence each.
lessons.home_link: Look at a baby photo together and talk about how much you've grown.

lessons.title: Story Time: 'When I Was Little' or Similar Growth Story
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to describe how the character has changed.
lessons.main_activity: Read a story about a character growing up, discussing changes noticed.
key_questions: How has the character changed?
What can they do now?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note comprehension of growth/change themes — evidence for LIT.1.
lessons.plenary: Discuss favourite part of the story.
lessons.home_link: Talk about how you've changed with family.

lessons.title: New Things I Can Do Independently
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to name a task they can now do independently that they needed help with before.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap independence skills learned this year (dressing, tidying, writing name).
lessons.main_activity: Children identify and demonstrate a task they can now do independently, celebrating their growing independence.
key_questions: What can you do by yourself now?
How did you learn to do it?

differentiation.extension: Explain the learning process in detail

lessons.assessment_notes: Note growing independence and self-awareness — evidence for PSED.2.
lessons.plenary: Class recap of independent skills celebrated.
lessons.home_link: Show a family member something you can now do independently.

lessons.title: How Animals Grow and Change
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to link human growth to animal growth and change learned about this year.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap the chick and butterfly life cycles.
lessons.main_activity: Discuss how humans, like animals, grow and change over time, comparing baby-to-adult stages simply.
resources_needed: Human and animal growth picture cards
key_questions: How are we similar to animals in how we grow?
What stages do humans go through?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note connections made across the year's science learning — evidence for UTW.1/UTW.3.
lessons.plenary: Recap how all living things grow and change.
lessons.home_link: Talk about how a family pet or plant has grown and changed.

lessons.title: Writing About Growing Up
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to attempt to write a sentence about something they want to do when they're bigger.
lessons.starter_activity: Discuss things children look forward to doing when they're older.
lessons.main_activity: Children draw and attempt to write 'When I grow up I want to ___' using known phonics sounds.
key_questions: What do you want to do when you're bigger?
Can you write about it?

differentiation.extension: Independent phonetic attempt at a short sentence

lessons.assessment_notes: Note writing progress and future-oriented thinking — evidence for LIT.3.
lessons.plenary: Share hopes for the future with a partner.
lessons.home_link: Talk about what you'd like to do when you grow up.

lessons.title: Friendships That Have Grown This Year
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to describe how a friendship has developed since September.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap the friend-making activities from Week 1 and Week 15.
lessons.main_activity: Children think about a friendship that has grown this year, discussing what they enjoy doing together now.
key_questions: Who is a good friend you've made this year?
What do you enjoy doing together?

differentiation.extension: Explain how the friendship has changed/grown

lessons.assessment_notes: Note reflective understanding of relationships over time — evidence for PSED.3.
lessons.home_link: Tell a friend or family member why you value them.

lessons.title: What Will Change Next Year?
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to predict a way they might change or grow next year.
lessons.main_activity: Children predict how they might change or what new things they might learn to do next year (in Year 1).
key_questions: What do you think you'll be able to do next year?
What are you looking forward to learning?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note forward-thinking and understanding of continued growth — evidence for UTW.1/PSED.1.
lessons.plenary: Class recap of predictions for next year.
lessons.home_link: Talk about what you're looking forward to in Year 1.

lessons.title: Retelling the Growing Up Story
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to retell the story's key events showing change over time.
lessons.main_activity: Using picture cards, children retell the character's growth journey using sequencing words.
key_questions: What happened first?
How did the character change?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note sequencing and understanding of change over time — evidence for LIT.1/UTW.1.
lessons.plenary: One group retells to the class.
lessons.home_link: Retell the story to someone at home.

lessons.title: Celebrating My Achievements This Year
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to identify their proudest achievement from the year.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap the year's key moments and learning.
lessons.main_activity: Children choose and share their proudest achievement from the year, contributing to an 'Achievements' certificate or display.
key_questions: What are you most proud of this year?
How did you achieve it?

differentiation.extension: Explain the journey to achieving it

lessons.assessment_notes: Note reflective self-esteem and pride in accomplishment — evidence for PSED.1.
lessons.home_link: Share your proudest achievement from this year with your family.

lessons.title: A Timeline of My Year
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to sequence key events/topics from across the school year.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap key topics from across the year (starting school, festivals, minibeasts, etc.).
lessons.main_activity: Children help create a simple class timeline sequencing the year's key topics/events in order.
resources_needed: Large timeline display, topic picture cards from across the year
key_questions: What did we learn about first this year?
What came after that?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note understanding of chronological sequencing across a whole year — evidence for UTW.1.
lessons.plenary: Walk through the completed class timeline together.
lessons.home_link: Talk through the year's timeline with your family.

lessons.title: Phonics: Reading Growth-Themed Words
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to blend and read simple growth-themed words.
lessons.main_activity: Phonics stations reading growth-themed word cards and simple sentences (e.g. 'I am big now').
key_questions: Can you read this word?
Can you read this sentence?

differentiation.support: Read simple CVC words with support

lessons.assessment_notes: Note phonics application to themed vocabulary — evidence for LIT.2.
lessons.plenary: Celebrate reading progress with a themed reading game.
lessons.home_link: Practise reading growth-themed words over the week.

lessons.title: Growing and Change Recap Circle
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to reflect on and share their growth journey this year.
lessons.starter_activity: Recap the week's learning about growing and change.
lessons.main_activity: Circle time reflection where children share one thing they've learned about themselves this year.
key_questions: What have you learned about yourself this year?
What are you looking forward to?

differentiation.support: Point to a photo and share simply

lessons.assessment_notes: Note reflective language and self-awareness — evidence for PSED.1.
lessons.plenary: Class celebration of growth and change this year.
lessons.home_link: Share your reflections from this week with your family.

lessons.title: Growing and Change Recap Display
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to summarise key ideas about growth and change learned this week.
lessons.main_activity: Contribute to a class 'How We've Grown' display combining the timeline, achievements, and baby-to-now comparisons.
key_questions: What have we learned about growing and changing?
What was most interesting?
lessons.assessment_notes: Note synthesis of the week's learning — evidence for UTW.1.
lessons.home_link: Share what you learned about growing and changing with your family.

lessons.title: Growing and Change Quiz Game
lessons.learning_objective: Children will be able to answer recall questions about growth and change learned this week.
lessons.main_activity: Quiz-style game asking questions about the topics from this week and the year overall.
key_questions: What could you do as a baby?
What are you looking forward to in Year 1?
lessons.assessment_notes: Assess recall and comprehension — evidence for LIT.1/CL.1.
lessons.home_link: Quiz your family on what you've learned this week.
